name: charter
description: Charter — governed verb API for AI agents. Audited, permissioned, actor-identified verbs with embedded business logic. Connect your own Airtable, BigQuery, and HubSpot stacks through a governed verb interface.

charter_url.title: Charter bridge URL
charter_url.description: Base URL of your charter bridge deployment (e.g. https://charter.example.com)

credential.title: Charter credential
credential.description: Cloudflare Access + API key credential (format: cf-client-id:cf-client-secret:api-key). Get this from your bridge operator.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth client ID
google_client_id.description: Your Google OAuth client ID for actor identity (e.g. xxx.apps.googleusercontent.com). Create one at https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/credentials

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth client secret
google_client_secret.description: Your Google OAuth client secret (from your Google Cloud console).

domain_hint.title: Email domain hint
domain_hint.description: Optional: hint the Google sign-in flow to prefer this domain (e.g. @example.com). The server still verifies the actual email.

hubspot_client_id.title: HubSpot OAuth client ID
hubspot_client_id.description: Optional: your HubSpot app client ID for HubSpot identity connection.
